author: bombolopanzo
body: Don't worry it's absolutely normal, in the beginning you'll grow fast but after a certain point leveling up will be slower. My suggestion is not to rush things and enjoy the ride. In the end the events rerun every year so what you'll not be able to do now is not gonna be a problem since you'll be able to try again, and it's nice see how one can improve. If you hit a wall then just grind easier enemies and update your gear til you succeed

author: eserz
body:
You're good, the sooner you get to 225 the better usually (as long as you have owns for a t10 class).
That's where the real game starts.

author: BearTheFerret
body: I recommend when you get to t9 to stay there for a while and farm as many tower shards as humanly possible 😂 t10 is really rough early on to stockpile efficiently

author: permaculturegeek
body: That span probably took me six months! I embraced the grind and declined most offers of party exp. I know how to level faster, but you miss out on a lot of good gear. Been T12 for a few months now and getting into the swing of it

author: ThatCrossDresser
body: Once you cross over 200 or so you can't level up by killing random monsters in the over world. You can only level up grinding raids. You need to join a kingdom and do world raids as much as possible. You can get a good boost from dungeons and towers, but you need to raid as much as possible.
